subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear permanently replace the dedicated Agent and Session pages with compact Home controls and retain the new capability-gated model RPC contract?
rationale: The implementation is not merely a bug repair: it changes the primary Watch navigation model and establishes an additive companion protocol surface whose long-term UX and compatibility policy require owner intent.

options.title: Accept the consolidated Home workflow
options.body: Approve the Home-only context navigation and model-controls capability contract after the branch is rebased and refreshed.

options.title: Keep dedicated context pages
options.body: Retain the existing Agent and Session pages and narrow the branch to only independently approved improvements.

recommendation.title: Accept the consolidated Home workflow
recommendation.body: Approve the Home-only context navigation and model-controls capability contract after the branch is rebased and refreshed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned and authored the final hardening sequence for this Android/Wear design.
